plugin.name: still-surfaces
plugin._long: Keeps chosen parts of the shell (a dock, a panel) where they are while the desktops slide.

option.name: names
option._long: The names (layer-shell namespaces) of the surfaces that stay in place, separated by spaces.

option.name: sliding
option._long: The names of the surfaces that slide with the desktops as two: a picture of what the surface showed goes with the desktop that leaves, the surface itself comes with the new one. Separated by spaces.

option.name: during
option._long: The plugins during whose activity the surfaces stay in place, separated by spaces.
